column1: # Labels of the project documents that check-project-docs.py reads, in Vietnamese. The words of docs_high_names and the
# docs_destroy_* keys are separated by | and become a regular expression: a word is matched as written.
# docs_high_names are high-risk names of a screen, written without marks and spaces; docs_high_names_match is `squeezed`:
# the screen name is squeezed the same way before it is searched (use `word` for a language whose words are separated by spaces).
# Words of a File Diff row that destroy data or break a caller: "<verb> <object>", then whole phrases.
# Names of high-risk work in a screen name or route, without marks or separators.
